declared.step: Every test's cost against the budget it declares
declared.why: Added in v3.92 and not yet measured by a recording: it reads the two vitest reports the coverage step wrote and compares each test's duration with the budget its file declares, so its cost is two file reads and a walk over 253 names. It is the last step of its job for the reason the rule gives -- a bound after an unmeasured step would be argued from a sum with a hole. The round that measures it deletes this sentence.
